posts.title: BYD unveils Ocean lineup's first flagship MPV Whale, set to launch in Q1 2027
posts.summary:
The Whale is expected to target the 300,000 yuan ($44,730) price segment, and is the fourth MPV model from the BYD Group.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: BYD unveiled the 'Whale,' a flagship MPV for its Ocean lineup, scheduled for a commercial launch in the first quarter of 2027.
The vehicle will be available in both plug-in hybrid and battery electric versions, with the latter boasting a CLTC range exceeding 900 km.
Targeting the 300,000 yuan price segment, the Whale features advanced flash-charging technology capable of reaching 97% charge in just 9 minutes.

posts.title: SAIC's MG goes all-in on NEVs, to halt ICE vehicle production for Chinese mainland in 2027
posts.summary:
MG's move comes as China's passenger NEV retail penetration rate approaches the 70% mark, with the market share of gas-powered cars shrinking rapidly.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: SAIC's MG brand will cease production of pure internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles for the Chinese mainland market effective January 1, 2027.
The decision reflects the rapid shift in China's automotive market, where NEV retail penetration is projected to exceed 70% by the end of November 2026.
MG will continue to support existing ICE owners with maintenance and parts, while its overseas operations remain unaffected by this domestic strategic pivot.

posts.title: Nio Firefly reaches 100,000 cumulative deliveries as shipments set to exceed 10,000 this month for first time
posts.summary:
Firefly's 100,000th delivery came 42 days after it surpassed the 90,000 mark on October 16.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Nio's Firefly brand reached the 100,000 cumulative delivery milestone just 19 months after its market entry.
The brand is experiencing significant momentum, with November deliveries expected to surpass 10,000 units for the first time.
Firefly has become a critical volume driver for Nio Inc, accounting for 22.6% of the parent company's total deliveries in October.

posts.title: Leapmotor updates Lafa 5 electric hatchback with up to 640 km range in year-end sales push
posts.summary:
The updated Lafa 5 carries an official guide price starting at 105,800 yuan ($15,770), with a limited-time discount lowering the entry price to 102,800 yuan.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Leapmotor launched an updated Lafa 5 electric hatchback featuring an 800-volt high-voltage platform capable of 30% to 80% charging in 16 minutes.
The new model offers a maximum CLTC range of 640 kilometers and integrates advanced smart driving features powered by a Qualcomm chip and LiDAR.
Pricing for the updated hatchback starts at 105,800 yuan, with limited-time promotional discounts lowering the entry point to 102,800 yuan.

posts.title: The Download: Innovators Under 35 nominations are open, and a bionic window into the mind
posts.summary: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. Our 2027 Innovators Under 35 competition is now open Every year, MIT Technology Review honors 35 of the world’s brightest young scientists, entrepreneurs, and inventors in our Innovators Under 35 list.…
bullets: Nvidia has halted server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries, signaling a significant tightening of export controls on AI-capable hardware.
The move has prompted Singapore to actively lobby the US government to maintain access to critical AI chips, highlighting the region's deep economic dependency on Nvidia's supply chain.
While Asian markets face uncertainty regarding AI infrastructure, Chinese chip stocks have experienced record-breaking growth, suggesting a potential shift in regional market dynamics.
MIT Technology Review has officially opened nominations for its 2027 Innovators Under 35 list, seeking global talent in scientific and technological fields.
